findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_available_states, start_quote · Private data: next_question, start_quote, answer_carrier_questions, answer_other_carrier_questions, submit_commercial_application · Public sink: next_question, find_occupation, start_quote, resolve_application_link, carrier_questions, answer_carrier_questions, answer_other_carrier_questions, submit_commercial_application · Destructive: start_quote.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_available_states, start_quote · Private data: next_question, start_quote, answer_carrier_questions, answer_other_carrier_questions, submit_commercial_application · Public sink: next_question, find_occupation, start_quote, resolve_application_link, carrier_questions, answer_carrier_questions, answer_other_carrier_questions, submit_commercial_application · Destructive: start_quote

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
